tools.name: drug-database.search_drug
tools.description: Typeahead search across the worldwide drug master (CH + EU + US public sources). Free tier: 100 req/day per host, capped at 5 results. Returns name, ATC, identifiers, dispensing category, reimbursement flag.

tools.name: drug-database.atc_lookup
tools.description: Browse the WHO ATC tree. Returns the node, its parents, children, and DDD where defined. Free; no API key required.

tools.name: drug-database.schema_docs
tools.description: Field reference for the GraphQL types (Drug, Interaction, AtcCode, Identifier, Monograph). Bundled locally — no network call.

type.description: Restrict the response to a single type. Omit to get all.

tools.name: drug-database.get_drug
tools.description: Full drug record: identifiers, indications, contraindications, dispensing category, reimbursement status, monograph link. Requires DRUG_DATABASE_API_KEY.

id.description: Internal drug UUID. Use this OR (system + code).

tools.name: drug-database.check_interactions
tools.description: Pairwise + N-way interaction check across an ATC-mapped drug list. Resolves drug_id / ATC / any supported identifier (Pharmacode, NDC11, CIP-13, PZN, RxCUI, UNII, dm+d AMPPID, …) to the canonical record and returns severity-ranked interactions with mechanism and recommendation. Requires DRUG_DATABASE_API_KEY.

tools.name: drug-database.validate_prescription
tools.description: Clinical validation of a proposed prescription against current medications and coarse, non-identifying context (age band, eGFR band, pregnancy, conditions). Runs in-project — no external gateway — and processes NO PHI: it accepts only drug identifiers, and identifying fields (names, DOBs, MRNs) are rejected. Returns interactions, proposed-drug interactions, advisories, and a severity_max. Requires DRUG_DATABASE_API_KEY with the interactions:write scope (Growth plan and above).

tools.name: drug-database.list_changes
tools.description: Diff feed: what changed across any loaded jurisdiction (CH + EU + US public sources) since a given timestamp. Cursor-paginated, capped at 500 records per page. Requires DRUG_DATABASE_API_KEY.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from prior call.

tools.name: drug-database.get_drug_profile
tools.description: Everything about one drug in a single call: the core record plus the full 16-section aggregated profile — label texts (indications, warnings, interactions), per-country pricing (CH BAG SL + US NADAC), adverse events, molecular pharmacology (ChEMBL targets/mechanisms), CH monograph, and cross-country availability. Accepts { id } or { system, code } (resolved to the canonical record first). Requires DRUG_DATABASE_API_KEY.

id.description: Internal drug UUID. Use this OR (system + code).

tools.name: drug-database.check_pharmacogenomics
tools.description: CPIC pharmacogenomics for a drug by name: whether a CPIC gene-drug guideline exists, the genes involved, and the phenotype→recommendation dosing matrix. Source: cpicpgx.org (open). Requires DRUG_DATABASE_API_KEY.

name.description: Drug name (e.g. simvastatin, clopidogrel) to look up CPIC pharmacogenomics for.

tools.name: drug-database.find_drug_targets
tools.description: Molecular targets and mechanisms of action for a drug by name, from Open Targets (public domain): mechanisms with their target gene symbols, the deduped target list, clinical indications, and curated drug warnings. Requires DRUG_DATABASE_API_KEY.

name.description: Drug name (e.g. imatinib) to resolve molecular targets / mechanisms of action for.

tools.name: drug-database.compare_market_prices
tools.description: Compare a drug's price ACROSS MARKETS. Accepts any identifier (substance/INN, brand, WHO ATC, UUID, or pharmacode/GTIN/NDC/CIP13/PZN), resolves it to the substance, and returns each market's median price-per-DDD in USD (the comparable gradient value) plus native price, basis (per_ddd/per_unit/per_pack) and price_type (acquisition/retail/reimbursement). Optional `countries` filter ("all" or e.g. "CH,US,FR"). Requires DRUG_DATABASE_API_KEY.

q.description: Any drug identifier — a substance/INN, brand name, WHO ATC code, internal UUID, or a pharmacode/GTIN/NDC/CIP13/PZN. It is resolved to the substance, then priced across every market.

countries.description: Optional market filter: "all" (default) or a comma-separated ISO-2 list, e.g. "CH,US,FR,JP". Omit to compare every priced market.

tools.name: drug-database.assess_feasibility
tools.description: COMPOSED feasibility view for a drug × indication in ONE call — replaces 6+ separate lookups. Fuses drug→targets, human-genetic support + directionality-concordance (does the mechanism phenocopy the protective genetics?), target de-risking (essentiality / LoF constraint / tractability / safety), LINCS repurposing reversal, and clinical guidelines + HTA, plus a summary rollup. Requires DRUG_DATABASE_API_KEY.

drug.description: Drug name (e.g. evolocumab) whose feasibility for the indication to assess.

indication.description: Disease label or ontology id (e.g. 'familial hypercholesterolemia' or MONDO_0005439).

tools.name: drug-database.assess_target_genetics
tools.description: Human-genetic causal support for a target × disease, with the piece Open Targets does not compute: the directionality-CONCORDANCE verdict (drug mechanism vs the genetically-protective direction) plus a de-risking profile (DepMap essentiality, gnomAD LoF constraint, tractability, safety liabilities). Pass `drug` for the concordance verdict. Requires DRUG_DATABASE_API_KEY.

gene.description: Gene symbol or Ensembl id (e.g. PCSK9 or ENSG00000169174).

disease.description: Disease label or ontology id (e.g. 'familial hypercholesterolemia').

drug.description: Optional drug name — enables the directionality-concordance verdict: does the drug's mechanism phenocopy the protective human genetics?

tools.name: drug-database.find_repurposing_candidates
tools.description: Mechanism-agnostic repurposing leads: scores a curated disease expression signature against LINCS L1000 and returns the compounds that most REVERSE it (candidate therapeutics) — an efficacy signal independent of any target hypothesis. Only curated indications are supported; an unmatched name returns the available list. Requires DRUG_DATABASE_API_KEY.

indication.description: Curated indication label (e.g. endometriosis). Only indications with a curated disease signature are supported; an unmatched name returns the available list.

tools.name: drug-database.ask
tools.description: Ask a natural-language question about medicines — dosing, mechanisms, interactions, pharmacogenomics, availability, pricing — answered from the Drug Database corpus. Conversational (pass `conversation_id` to continue). TOKEN-METERED billing; requires DRUG_DATABASE_API_KEY with the `chat:write` scope (Growth+ tiers).

message.description: A natural-language question about medicines — dosing, mechanisms, indications, contraindications, adverse effects, pharmacogenomics, drug–drug interactions, availability, or pricing — answered from the Drug Database corpus (610k+ drugs, 19 jurisdictions).

conversation_id.description: Continue a prior conversation by passing the `conversation_id` from a previous answer.

residency.description: Optional ISO-2 market to bias availability/pricing/regulatory answers, e.g. "CH".
